data.body:
Root cause W1 confirmed and fixed in the worktree (fix-3b27-stale-review, base 3beb7e4ad23).

Evidence: in-process repro with no LLM — begin_gate_job, edit_ticket, begin_gate_job -> is_new=False and the same job_id, while show_ticket already returned the edited text. Tool-level red: the 2 new tests in tests/unit/test_mcp_llm_dedup.py failed on the base (review_plan_start returned the same job id; sync review_plan ran the gate 1 time instead of 2, sharing the stale run).

Fix: _mcp_llm._plan_review_variant adds `material=<current plan-material fingerprint>` (attest.current_material_fingerprint, a light read) to the dedup variant at both plan-review call sites; the async start computes it in the worker thread, not on the event loop. Unchanged material still dedups (existing tests pass). 43 passed across test_mcp_llm_dedup, test_mcp_inflight, test_mcp_gate_async. make lint and make typecheck pass; make verify running.

W2 (cross-clone 60 s fetch throttle) is tracked in glandulous-minor-aurochs. Side observation while working this ticket: I edited this description from a local clone and waited 90 s before review_plan_start; the resulting REVIEW_RESULT pins description hash 52943bbb44fe9393 (5716 chars), equal to the current description.
